total = sum(weights)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("weights must add up to more than zero")
    sign = -1 if amount_cents < 0 else 1
    amount = abs(amount_cents)
    shares = [amount * weight // total for weight in weights]
    by_remainder = sorted(
        range(len(weights)), key=lambda index: (-(amount * weights[index] % total), index)
    )
    for index in by_remainder[: amount - sum(shares)]:
        shares[index] += 1
    return [sign * share for share in shares]
